articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) ("Mawson"), a digital infrastructure company, today announced plans for expansion of the Company's Midland, Pennsylvania digital infrastructure and bitcoin digital mining facilities to 120 MW and is expected to increase total miner capacity at that operational site to about 38,810 miners.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Announces Expansion Plans at Midland, Pennsylvania Facilities

articles.summary: MIDLAND, Pa., April 01, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson”, the Company), a digital infrastructure company, today announced its financial and operational results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2023 ended December 31, 2023.
